title: Best Marketing Automation Platforms: Find Your Match (Compare These 15 Options) | Thinkific

facts.fact: The marketing technology landscape spans 9,932 solutions, according to a chiefmartec/MartechMap 2022 search cited by the page.
facts.quote: Currently, the landscape of marketing technology spans a[whopping 9,932 solutions](https://chiefmartec.com/2022/05/marketing-technology-landscape-2022-search-9932-solutions-on-martechmap-com/)

facts.fact: The marketing technology landscape has expanded 24 percent over recent years, per the page.
facts.quote: It’s expanded 24 percent over recent years.

facts.fact: The page reports 353 marketing automation platform options currently captured in the category.
facts.quote: Marketing automation platforms, with 353 options currently captured in the category.

facts.fact: The global marketing automation market was valued at around USD 4 billion in 2019, per Grand View Research as cited by the page.
facts.quote: In 2019, the global marketing automation market was valued at around [USD 4 billion]

facts.fact: The global marketing automation market was valued at almost USD 7 billion in 2024, per thecmo.com as cited by the page.
facts.quote: In 2024, it’s valued at almost [USD 7 billion](https://thecmo.com/marketing-automation/marketing-automation-market-size/)

facts.fact: 91 percent of marketers who use marketing automation platforms say the technology is very important to their digital marketing success, per invespcro.com as cited by the page.
facts.quote: Ask marketers who use marketing automation platforms how important the technology is to the overall success of their digital marketing strategies, and[91 percent will tell you](https://www.invespcro.com/blog/marketing-automation/): very!

facts.fact: One market research estimate suggests marketing automation platforms can help reduce marketing overhead costs by as much as 12.2 percent.
facts.quote: marketing automation platforms can help reduce marketing overhead costs by as much as[12.2 percent.]

facts.fact: Michael Kiel reports a minimum 12% reduction in marketing overhead costs from using HubSpot in his past agency businesses (a single testimonial, not a verified study).
